scope: Native Records create HTTP route and the generic workplace POST cutover for the bounded support module. The TypeScript writer remains the explicit fallback when the native Records configuration is absent.
changes: POST /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/records/{module_id} on the owner-local native router.
The route requires the exact origin, a valid Idempotency-Key, application/json, a bounded body and the current Account/Holding target before reaching the backend.
RecordsBackend now owns the command service and returns the created id plus the current validated context.
The native transport client has a create method that sends the exact origin, idempotency key, cookie and bounded JSON, and returns the created id.

The workplace generic POST calls the native client and performs a fresh native list readback only when ERPX_NATIVE_RECORDS_CONFIG is present; otherwise the retained TypeScript writer remains the explicit fallback.
The Rust router test covers valid create plus foreign origin, short key and malformed JSON.
